stem:
During a morning health check, four healthy students have these body temperatures: 36.6 °C, 36.9 °C, 37.1 °C, and 37.3 °C.

What is the best conclusion?

options.text: All four can be healthy; 37.0 °C is an average, so small differences around it are usual.
Anyone below 37.0 °C has an abnormally low temperature.
41.5 °C could also be normal for a healthy student.
Every healthy student's reading must be exactly 37.0 °C.

teacher.key_rationale: 37.0 °C is an average. Small differences around it are usual for healthy students.
